**$0 federal**, assuming the QSBS status holds.

- **Exclusion:** stock acquired after 9/27/2010 & held >5 yrs gets 100% §1202 exclusion, w/ no AMT preference & no 3.8% NIIT on the excluded gain.
- **Cap:** greater of $10M or 10x basis, per issuer. $8M fits under it.

What would change that:
- **Prior exclusions:** earlier excluded gains on the same company's stock reduce the $10M cap. Any excess is taxed at 23.8%, unless 10x basis gives a higher cap.
- **Filing status:** married filing separately cuts the cap to $5M each.
- **State:** CA, PA, AL & MS don't conform & tax the gain in full (CA up to 13.3%, approx. $1M+).

Still report the sale on Form 8949 w/ code Q. Get the company's QSBS attestation letter before closing.
